Sønderborg is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). The report, which covers the clinical period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, benchmarks treatment quality across all 98 Danish municipalities to support local quality development and decentralized responsibility in the healthcare system. 

In the context of Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulation (AC) treatment using DanStroke registry data, Sønderborg recorded 4 ischemic stroke events among a cohort of 2,096 atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. This represents an observed rate of 0.2%, compared to an expected rate of 0.3%, yielding a relative ratio of 0.7 [^src1]. 

Additionally, Sønderborg's performance is detailed in the report's assessment of anticoagulation treatment coverage and safety practices (Indicators 4a and 4b) [^src2]. The municipality achieved a treatment coverage rate of 95.5%, with 1,514 out of 1,586 eligible patients receiving anticoagulation therapy [^src2]. Furthermore, regarding safety practices and the use of Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs), Sønderborg met the criteria for 1,458 out of 1,506 patients, resulting in a compliance rate of 96.8% against an expected baseline of 94.8% [^src2].
